dedupe_keys.name: form eia 861 annual electric power industry report us utility sales customers service territories reliability saidi and saifi and metering

description: Form EIA-861, the Annual Electric Power Industry Report, with its short form EIA-861S, is a census of all United States electric utilities, collecting data from distribution utilities and power marketers. The detailed files hold the individual survey responses in topic files: sales to ultimate customers with revenue, megawatt-hours and customer counts by state and sector from 1990; service territories listing the counties where each utility distributes electricity, from 2001; reliability from 2013, with system average interruption duration and frequency indices (SAIDI and SAIFI) and the conditions under which they were collected; advanced metering counts from 2007; demand response, dynamic pricing and distribution system circuits from 2013; and balancing authorities from 2012, among others. Early release 2026 data (for 2025) were published on 4 August 2026, with final data due in October 2026. Coverage is US utilities by state. Files are Excel workbooks, free to download; as US government works they are in the public domain and EIA asks for acknowledgement. Caveats: utilities may compute SAIDI and SAIFI with IEEE standards or other methods, and short-form respondents report less detail. Simulation uses are utility reliability baselines, customer counts for outage impact models and service territory mapping. Related records: data-pudl processes EIA-861, and data-eagle-i-recorded-electricity-outages-us-counties gives event-level outage counts.
